Pancake Muffins
By: risten
Published: Thursday, December 10, 2009 - 4:59pm

Ingredients




2 cups complete pancake mix
1 cup water
 cup sausage links, cut

Preparation

1 Brown sausage, drain. 2 Mix water and pancake mix. 3 Fold in Sausage. 4 Pour into greased muffin tin. 5 Bake 350 degrees 15-18 min.

About


I need fast, hearty breakfasts for my family.  I started playing around with the idea of a pancake muffin and this is what I came up with.  I have varied it by using bacon instead of sausage, adding berries, and adding cheese and chilies.  All of the varieties are quick and delicious.

Comments:
Melissa Peterman

What a fun idea for breakfast!
